title: services.packages.void_check params
description: Read-only pre-check of voiding a sold voucher (services#82): can :grant_id be voided? Returns voidable (0/1), the business reason (grant_not_found | already_voided | in_use) and the sessions spent or held. It does not mutate; the transactional authority is still services.packages.void_grant.

grant_id.description: Id of the grant to void.
